prompt: Rent in the city has been steadily rising for ten years.
why: A long, steady direction is a trend.
trap: It doesn't repeat each year; it keeps climbing.

prompt: Newspaper sales fell a little almost every year since 2000.
tells: fell a little almost every year since 2000
why: A long-run decline is a downward trend.
trap: Yearly drops aren't seasonal; they're one direction.

prompt: Daily sales jump around, but over the year they clearly drift upward.
tells: over the year they clearly drift upward
why: Underneath the noise there's a trend.
trap: Noise is the jumping; the drift is the trend.

prompt: Before comparing months, the analyst removes the long upward climb.
why: Taking out the trend shows other patterns.
trap: Smoothing is different; this removes the long direction.

prompt: The app gains a few more users each month, month after month.
Global average temperatures rise slowly across decades despite cold years.
tells: rise slowly across decades despite cold years
why: Long-run rise is a trend; cold years are noise.
trap: Cold years are noise; the decades show the trend.
